sentences.en: The gold coin was much more valuable than was supposed.
sentences.zh: 那枚金币的价值远超预期。

sentences.en: My daughter lost almost all the coins she had collected.
sentences.zh: 我女儿几乎丢失了她收集的所有硬币。

sentences.en: He came across this old coin in an antique shop.
sentences.zh: 他在一家古董店发现了一枚旧硬币。

senses.zh: 硬币，钱币；金属货币；（一枚）硬币；(coins) 塔罗牌中的一种花色
铸造（货币）；杜撰，创造（新词，短语）
